summary: Bloomington should retain its standalone municipal control row. Official city sources show a live Bloomington Police Department plus continuing city-level crime publication through annual-report and crime-map surfaces, while the official Illinois portal states that 2023-forward agency publication is gated on NIBRS certification. The current all-fill condition is therefore best treated as a valid-target state-publication or continuity gap, compounded by a repo source-promotion mismatch, not as McLean County replacement or target invalidity.
